sample_unit: texts (119 web pages and 30 ChatGPT-4o-generated texts)

links.outcome: Understandability and readability of AI-generated versus web mpox education texts
links.effect: AI texts more understandable: 80% (24/30) scored ≥70% on PEMAT-P (P<.001). Readability higher for AI (mean 2.9, SD 0.4) than web pages (mean 2.4, SD 1.0; P=.009). Actionable guidance largely absent in AI content.
links.quote: AI-generated texts significantly outperformed web pages in understandability, with 80% (24/30) scoring ≥70% in PEMAT-P (P<.001).

screen.reason: Evaluates LLM-generated Japanese patient education materials for mpox compared to traditional web materials using PEMAT-P and readability metrics, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard or operational practice.
